title: Three-point light rig with illuminance ratios
purpose: Add key, fill and rim area lights aimed at a target, placed by azimuth and elevation, with fill and rim powers derived from illuminance ratios at their distances. Use it to light a subject for product, character or turntable renders.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Point the three lights aim at; the rig empty sits here.

parameters.name: key_distance
parameters.description: Distance from the target to the key light.

parameters.name: fill_distance
parameters.description: Distance from the target to the fill light.

parameters.name: rim_distance
parameters.description: Distance from the target to the rim light.

parameters.name: key_azimuth
parameters.description: Key light angle around Z; 0 is in front (-Y), positive toward +X.

parameters.name: key_elevation
parameters.description: Key light angle above the target's horizontal plane.

parameters.name: fill_elevation
parameters.description: Fill light angle above the horizontal plane.

parameters.name: rim_azimuth
parameters.description: Rim light angle around Z; near 180 places it behind the subject.

parameters.name: rim_elevation
parameters.description: Rim light angle above the horizontal plane.

parameters.name: key_power
parameters.description: Power of the key area light.

parameters.name: key_fill_ratio
parameters.description: Key illuminance divided by fill illuminance at the target.

parameters.name: rim_ratio
parameters.description: Rim illuminance relative to the key at the target.

parameters.name: light_size
parameters.description: Edge of the square key and fill area lights; the rim light is half this size.

outputs.description: An empty with three parented area lights constrained to aim at it.

limits: Powers follow the inverse square law from each light's centre, which is approximate for area lights that are large compared with their distance. The ratios hold at the target point only. Colours are linear RGB values, not colour temperatures. The lights stay aimed by Track To constraints on the rig empty; glTF export keeps their positions but not the constraints. Verified in Blender 5.2.1 with Cycles; written for the 4.2 API.
technique_references: Three-point lighting: key, fill and rim (back) light
Inverse square law to hold illuminance ratios across distances
Euler XYZ angles that point the -Z axis along a direction
